newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Bear return to Prague bourse after one-day hiatus.
newsitem.headline: Bear return to Prague bourse after one-day hiatus.

text.p: The Prague Stock Exchange, after a one-session upturn, returned to its bearish ways on Friday, with slight losses to most major shares pushing the market lower.
SPT Telecom and Skoda both edged higher in modest trading, but most other blue chips lost ground as the PX50 index closed down two points at 491.1. For the week, the index was down 15.3 points.
Overall on the PSE, 120 issues rose, while 104 fell and 51 held steady. A total of 4,140.278 shares change hands on turnover of 1.28 billion crowns.
Dealers said they did not see any new impetus to stop the bourse's downturn in the coming week, though losses should be minor.
